principle: a gate may only be entered when its predecessor is passed; a failed gate retires its hypothesis

gates.title: measurement baseline
exit: dump row count == harness n for every model
2M vs 150k ~ 0 and 2M vs 1.2M ~ +0.5 pp in the paired table
gates.abort: harness build differs from the released one

gates.title: alignment screen V1 vs V9
gates.on_fail: V9 retires, G2 skipped, G3 runs against V1

gates.title: alignment confirm 2M @30k
gates.abort: two GPU-nights total; no re-runs with changed hyperparameters
gates.on_fail: V1 stays reference; V9 documented as negative

gates.title: repair screens V2/V3/V8
exit: promote every variant with delta <= -0.02 nats
gates.abort: mask raises loss by > 0.05 nats -> V2/V3/V8 retire together
gates.on_fail: documented negative; G4 skipped for that variant

gates.title: repair confirm
exit: delta <= -0.02 nats vs G2 winner at 30k

gates.title: budget sweep + checkpoint averaging
exit: pick lowest heldout loss whose curve did not rise in two consecutive evals
average of last three evals not worse than best member
gates.abort: stop at the first leg beating the previous by < 0.01 nats (plateau)

gates.title: export + final paired eval
exit: OR heldout ppl better by >= 0.1 with Glide CI lower >= -0.5 pp
gates.rule: never ship on a single marginal p; the rule is the CI

gates.title: optional local contract test (9B, 100k)
exit: new target contract beats current by >= 0.05 nats at equal steps
gates.purpose: cheap falsification before any H100 booking
